head: ff99317450784c9563f5b6a2308c98e8262df98d
scope: Unified state-format reader/writer compatibility, migration, and rollback protection: entry-point precheck, restartable migration, single-writer ordering, Invariant 7/9/10 coverage.

validation.command: go build -o /tmp/agentshield-drill ./cmd/agentshield && serve on corrupt/future/symlink/legacy dirs

invariants.7_append_only: PutVersioned/PutGrant append-only; migration never re-signs or rewrites in place
invariants.9_same_uid: symlink marker -> corrupt; publishReplaceFile refuses symlink target; hard-link/O_EXCL on immutable publish
invariants.10_no_forged_evidence: migration only republishes marker + appends audit; never touches evidence/, never re-signs
